subject: data.open
name: Open-data portal or policy
what_would_settle_it: A Malian government open-data portal, open-data policy or right-to-information instrument, or an official statement that none exists.
disposition: found and staged — an academic evaluation establishes that Mali has no single access-to-information law and that the right is split across Loi 98-012, Loi 2013-015 and Loi 2017-062; staged to new/. The INSTAT microdata catalogue is raised as an acquisition line; the Mali data portal is a third-party host, not a government one.

subject: geopol.usa
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: United States bilateral digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A US government programme document, agreement or funding decision on digital or data cooperation with Mali after the 2023 Digital Ecosystem Country Assessment.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the probe returned only the 2023 assessment the wiki already holds and a derived AI-readiness worksheet; nothing after it.

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: India bilateral digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A bilateral memorandum, DPI cooperation programme or ministerial readout naming a Mali-India digital instrument.
disposition: absence stands, dated — Mali is not among the 23 countries on India's own published list of India Stack and DPI memoranda as at 2026-02.

subject: infra.connect
name: National internet exchange point
what_would_settle_it: a published operator listing, peering record or regulator statement would settle it; probed 2026-09-06, decree 2017-0872 created a steering committee for putting an exchange point in place and nothing since says whether it reported or an exchange point was established

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A loi de règlement or year-end budget execution report for 2024 or 2025 giving payment against the digital lines, read into the budget extract.

subject: finance.sustain
name: FY2026 enacted budget, digital lines
what_would_settle_it: The enacted loi de finances 2026 or its credit-distribution decree, read into the budget extract; FY2026 holds bill-stage rows only.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A data-management law, hosting decree or government cloud policy requiring state data to be held in the national data centre; repatriation is stated as policy only.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Source code, operating skills and exit for the e-passport system
what_would_settle_it: The SECU-PASS Mali contract or a security-ministry statement on source-code ownership, administrative control and exit terms.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the Mali Digital 2020 contract
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the 2018 China Eximbank-financed contract with China International Telecommunications Construction Corporation, with its data, portability and exit clauses.
